name: 12d_dual_arm_traj_oncl_rawspan_noise
description: ONCL robustness sweep for 12d_dual_arm_traj with Gaussian noise added to training demonstrations. Noise std for each dimension j is train_noise_raw_span_ratio * raw_span_j, where raw_span_j is computed from the clean training demonstrations. Dimensions with near-zero span receive near-zero noise.

noise.formula: x_noisy[:, j] = x_clean[:, j] + Normal(0, (ratio * (max_j - min_j))^2)
noise.angle_postprocess: wrap RPY dimensions to [-pi, pi] after adding noise
noise.zero_span_policy: do not special-case zero-span dimensions; zero raw span implies zero noise

eval_policy: Evaluation remains clean; noise is applied only to training demonstrations.
